items.zh: 你也住这层吧？我刚搬来，怎么称呼？
items.scene: 电梯里遇到同层邻居，想认识一下

answers.en: You're on this floor too, right? I just moved in — I'm Wang Lei.
answers.note: 先确认同层再自报姓名；英语里报上自己的名字，对方一般会跟着报上名字，不显得唐突。

answers.en: Hey, do you live on this floor? I just moved in last week.
answers.note: 用问句开场，不说死对方住这层，语气最缓和，适合还不确定时。

answers.en: Hi, I think we're neighbors — I just moved into 502. What should I call you?
answers.note: 先点明邻居关系并报门牌，再直接问怎么称呼，略正式，适合聊了几句之后。

items.zh: 买菜回来啦？这附近哪家菜市场好？
items.scene: 楼道里碰到邻居拎着菜，想搭话

answers.en: Coming back from the market? Which one around here is good?
answers.note: 先顺着对方手里的菜打招呼，再问推荐，像熟人闲聊，最常用。

answers.en: Looks like you got groceries — where do you usually go around here?
answers.note: got groceries 是很随意的美式说法，问的是平时去哪儿买，适合年轻邻居。

answers.en: Is there a good market nearby? I'm still figuring out the area.
answers.note: 只问推荐并说明自己刚来，不评论对方买的东西，最稳妥，适合不熟的邻居。

items.zh: 这栋楼里住的都是老邻居吗？
items.scene: 楼下乘凉时跟大爷闲聊，想摸摸底

answers.en: Has it always been the same neighbors?
answers.note: 最直白，问楼里是不是多年都是同一批人，适合跟爱聊天的老人开口。

answers.en: Is this building mostly long-term residents?
answers.note: long-term residents 稍正式，像在了解小区构成，适合问物业或在正式场合。

answers.en: Have most people here been around for a while?
answers.note: most people 加 around for a while 更口语，问法笼统，适合楼下乘凉随口聊。

items.zh: 楼上半夜还在挪家具，我该上去说一声吗？
items.scene: 凌晨被吵醒，跟室友商量要不要出面

answers.en: The upstairs neighbors are moving furniture at midnight — should I go up and say something?
answers.note: 先讲清事实再问建议，语气中性，适合跟室友一起拿主意。

answers.en: Should I knock on their door about the noise?
answers.note: 直接问要不要上门，省掉背景，显得已经有行动倾向，适合脾气急的人。

answers.en: Do you think I should talk to them, or just let it go?
answers.note: 把说和不说摆成两个选项，语气犹豫，适合不想把关系搞僵时。

items.zh: 你们家还要装修多久啊？电钻吵得我头疼。
items.scene: 工作日下午在家办公，被电钻吵得受不了

answers.en: How much longer is the renovation going to take? The drilling is giving me a headache.
answers.note: 先问工期再说影响，直接但不骂人，适合已经忍了几天的邻居。

answers.en: Any idea when the drilling will be done? I work from home and it's rough.
answers.note: any idea 让语气变软，it's rough 点出难受，适合第一次开口。

answers.en: Sorry to bother you — how much longer will the work go on?
answers.note: 先道歉再问，最客气，适合第一次上门、怕对方觉得被指责。

items.zh: 楼下邻居又把电动车推上楼充电了，要不要跟物业说？
items.scene: 晚上看到邻居把电动车推进电梯，跟家人商量

answers.en: Someone's charging an e-bike upstairs again — should we tell management?
answers.note: 先讲事实再问要不要报物业，语气平静，适合跟家人商量。

answers.en: Did you see that e-bike in the elevator? I'm worried about the fire risk.
answers.note: 从亲眼看到说起，重点说担心起火，适合提醒身边的人。

answers.en: I don't want to be that neighbor, but should we say something about the e-bike?
answers.note: I don't want to be that neighbor 带自嘲，说明不想多事，适合怕被说管闲事。

items.zh: 你家有螺丝刀吗？我装个柜子差一把。
items.scene: 装柜子装到一半，敲邻居门借工具

answers.en: Do you have a screwdriver I could borrow? I'm putting together a cabinet.
answers.note: 直接问有没有并说明用途，最常用，邻居一听就知道你要干什么。

answers.en: Mind if I borrow a screwdriver? I'm halfway through putting a cabinet together and I can't find mine.
answers.note: Mind if 开头更随意，补一句自己的找不着了，适合打过照面的邻居。

answers.en: Sorry to bug you — any chance you have a screwdriver?
answers.note: 先道歉再问，最客气，适合第一次跟这位邻居说话。

items.zh: 能借你家梯子用十分钟吗？换个灯泡。
items.scene: 客厅灯坏了，自己家没梯子

answers.en: Can I borrow your ladder for ten minutes? I need to change a light bulb.
answers.note: 主动说清只用十分钟，让对方放心，适合不太熟的邻居。

answers.en: Would you mind lending me your ladder real quick?
answers.note: real quick 很随意，省掉用途，适合平时打过交道的邻居。

answers.en: Do you still have that ladder? Could I use it for a few minutes?
answers.note: 用 still 说明记得对方有梯子，显得熟络，适合之前借过东西的人。

items.zh: 有打气筒吗？我电动车胎没气了。
items.scene: 早上出门发现电动车胎瘪了，敲隔壁门

answers.en: Got a bike pump? My e-bike tire's out of air.
answers.note: 省略 Do you have，最口语，适合赶时间、跟熟人开口。

answers.en: Do you have a pump I could use? My e-bike needs air.
answers.note: 完整问句，说清是电动车不是自行车，适合怕对方听错时。

answers.en: Sorry, do you happen to have a tire pump? I'm stuck without one.
answers.note: happen to have 最客气，I'm stuck 说明着急，适合第一次借东西。

items.zh: 你快递到了，我帮你收一下？
items.scene: 快递员敲门，邻居不在家，你在业主群问

answers.en: Your package came — want me to grab it for you?
answers.note: 先告知再提议，grab 很口语，适合在群里跟熟邻居说。

answers.en: The delivery guy left your package with me. Should I keep it here?
answers.note: 说明已经代收，再问放哪儿，适合快递员直接把件给了你。

answers.en: I've got your package. Do you want me to leave it by your door?
answers.note: 给出放门口的具体方案，最周到，适合对方一时回不来。

items.zh: 你看到我放在门口的快递了吗？
items.scene: 下班回家发现门口快递不见了，问对门

answers.en: Did you see a package outside my door?
answers.note: 只问有没有看到，不预设对方拿了，最中性，适合先探口风。

answers.en: Hey, has anyone picked up my package? It was right here.
answers.note: 用 anyone 扩大范围，补一句就在这儿，暗示东西不见了，语气更急。

answers.en: I'm missing a package — did you happen to see anything?
answers.note: 先说东西丢了再问，happen to 留余地，语气客气，不想让对方有压力。

items.zh: 快递员好像把我的件送到你家了，我能过来拿吗？
items.scene: 物流显示已签收，自家却没有，敲邻居门

answers.en: I think the delivery guy dropped my package at your place — can I come grab it?
answers.note: 用 I think 留余地，再直接问能不能拿，最常用。

answers.en: Looks like my delivery got left at your door. Mind if I pick it up?
answers.note: Looks like 比 I think 更轻，Mind if 客气，适合不确定对方知情时。

answers.en: Sorry, I think there's been a mix-up — my package might be with you. Can I come get it?
answers.note: 先道歉再说可能送错，最后才问能不能拿，最委婉。

items.zh: 咱们这栋楼哪天收垃圾啊？
items.scene: 刚搬来，看到邻居拎垃圾下楼，顺口问

answers.en: What day is trash pickup around here?
answers.note: trash pickup 是美式常用说法，直接问星期几，最省事。

answers.en: When do they collect the trash in this building?
answers.note: 用 they 指物业或环卫，问的是这栋楼，比上一句更具体。

answers.en: Do you know the trash schedule? I keep missing it.
answers.note: 问时间表并承认自己总错过，语气随和，适合跟邻居多聊两句。

items.zh: 旧电池能直接扔垃圾桶吗？
items.scene: 收拾抽屉翻出一堆旧电池，问楼下邻居

answers.en: Can I just toss old batteries in the trash?
answers.note: toss 很口语，just 表示图省事，适合随口一问。

answers.en: Where do old batteries go? Are they okay in the regular trash?
answers.note: 先问该扔哪儿再确认能不能混扔，问得更细，适合怕分错类。

answers.en: Do batteries need to go somewhere special?
answers.note: 不预设答案，只问有没有专门回收，适合完全不清楚规定时。

items.zh: 这车位是我的，你知道这车是谁的吗？
items.scene: 下班回来发现自家车位停了别人的车

answers.en: This is my spot — any idea whose car that is?
answers.note: 先声明车位归属再问，直接但没发火，适合问保安或邻居。

answers.en: Someone's parked in my space. Do you know who it belongs to?
answers.note: 用陈述句讲事实，语气比上一句重，适合已经等了一会儿。

answers.en: Sorry, do you know who owns that car? It's in my spot.
answers.note: 先道歉再问，把车位信息放最后，最客气，不想闹僵。

items.zh: 朋友来我家，车能停哪儿？
items.scene: 周末有朋友开车来，在业主群问邻居

answers.en: Where can my friend park when they visit?
answers.note: 最简单直接，问访客能停哪，适合群里随口一问。

answers.en: Is there guest parking here, or do visitors have to park on the street?
answers.note: 给出两个选项让对方确认，问得更清楚，适合车位紧张时。

answers.en: My friend's driving over — any tips on where to park?
answers.note: 先说朋友要来再求建议，语气轻松，适合跟熟邻居打听。

items.zh: 我家下周开始装修，先跟你说一声，可能会有点吵。
items.scene: 装修前拎着水果去敲隔壁门打招呼

answers.en: We're starting renovations next week — just wanted to give you a heads-up.
answers.note: heads-up 是提前知会，语气自然，适合大多数邻居。

answers.en: Heads-up: work starts next week, so it might get loud. Sorry in advance.
answers.note: 把 heads-up 放句首更随意，还先道歉，适合关系不错的邻居。

answers.en: I wanted to let you know before the noise starts — we're remodeling next week.
answers.note: I wanted to let you know 最客气，适合跟长辈或不好惹的邻居说。

items.zh: 师傅下午两点要打墙，那个点你在家吗？
items.scene: 跟邻居确认打墙时间会不会吵到他

answers.en: The crew's knocking down a wall at two — will you be home then?
answers.note: crew 指施工队，先报时间再问在不在家，适合让对方提前避开。

answers.en: They need to do the loud work at two. Is that okay for you?
answers.note: 把噪音说成 loud work，语气委婉，像在征求同意。

answers.en: Would two o'clock work? That's when they're tearing down the wall.
answers.note: 用 Would...work 提议时间，最客气，适合对方之前抱怨过噪音。

items.zh: 周末小区广场那个活动，你去吗？
items.scene: 业主群里看到通知，碰到邻居随口问

answers.en: You going to that thing at the plaza this weekend?
answers.note: 省略 Are you，用 that thing 指活动，很随意，适合年轻邻居。

answers.en: Are you planning to go to the community event on Saturday?
answers.note: 完整问句加 community event，最清楚，适合不熟或年长的邻居。

answers.en: They're doing something at the plaza this weekend — you in?
answers.note: 先提活动再问 you in，像临时邀约，适合朋友式的邻居。

items.zh: 群里说停水到几点来着？
items.scene: 中午做饭发现没水，在楼道遇到邻居

answers.en: The group chat said the water's off until when?
answers.note: 直接问群里通知的截止时间，适合自己没看清消息时。

answers.en: Did they say what time the water comes back on?
answers.note: 问的是来水时间，不是停到几点，说法更顺口，适合跟邻居确认。

answers.en: Any idea when the water's coming back? I missed the notice.
answers.note: 承认自己错过通知，语气随和，适合不熟也能开口。

items.zh: 你家狗狗晚上能安静点吗？我孩子刚睡着。
items.scene: 晚上十点隔壁狗一直叫，敲门沟通

answers.en: Could you keep the dog quiet at night? My kid just fell asleep.
answers.note: 直接请求加说明原因，语气坚定但不冲，适合第一次沟通。

answers.en: Sorry to ask, but the barking wakes my kid up. Is there any way to keep the noise down?
answers.note: 先道歉再讲影响，再问有没有办法，最委婉，适合怕伤和气。

answers.en: Hey, the dog's been barking a lot at night — everything okay?
answers.note: 不直接提要求，先问对方是不是有事，最间接，适合关系不错。

items.zh: 你家狗不咬人吧？
items.scene: 电梯里遇到没牵绳的大狗，有点怕

answers.en: Is your dog friendly?
answers.note: 最常用的委婉问法，问的是狗温不温和，不直接提咬人。

answers.en: He doesn't bite, does he?
answers.note: 反义疑问句，紧张感更明显，适合狗已经凑过来时。

answers.en: Would you mind holding on to him? I'm a little scared of dogs.
answers.note: 不评价狗，直接请对方牵好并说自己怕，最有效也最礼貌。

items.zh: 我家猫昨天跑出去了，你在楼道见过吗？
items.scene: 猫从门缝溜走，挨家挨户问邻居

answers.en: My cat got out yesterday — have you seen her?
answers.note: 最短最急，got out 指从家里溜出去，适合挨户快速问。

answers.en: I'm looking for my cat. She slipped out last night. Did you notice anything?
answers.note: 先说在找猫再补细节，问得宽，适合对方可能只看到影子。

answers.en: Sorry to bother you — my cat's missing. Could you keep an eye out?
answers.note: 请对方之后帮忙留意，适合问过一遍、想扩大范围时。

items.zh: 刚才有人敲你家门吗？说是查水表的。
items.scene: 独自在家，听到有人挨户敲门，问对门

answers.en: Did someone knock on your door too? He said he was checking the water meter.
answers.note: 用 too 说明自家也被敲过，先问再补细节，适合核对是不是同一人。

answers.en: Hey, was that guy at your door? Said he was from the water company.
answers.note: 更随意，用 that guy 指人，适合跟熟邻居快速核对。

answers.en: Someone just came by claiming to check meters — did you let him in?
answers.note: claiming 带怀疑，重点问对方有没有放人进来，语气最警惕。

items.zh: 门禁卡丢了要怎么办？找物业还是房东？
items.scene: 楼下进不去，碰到邻居顺口问

answers.en: I lost my key card — should I call the management office or my landlord?
answers.note: 把两个选项都摆出来让对方选，最具体，适合想一次问清楚。

answers.en: Any idea how to replace a lost key card?
answers.note: 只问怎么补办，不预设找谁，语气最轻，适合随口一问。

answers.en: My access card is gone. Who do I even talk to about that?
answers.note: who do I even talk to 带点无奈，适合已经被卡在楼下时。
